evals.prompt: Commit my changes. (Three files are modified: src/services/plan.ts, test/plan.test.ts and README.md; plan.test.ts tests a new function added in plan.ts.)
evals.expected_output: The repo state and recent log are read, each file's diff is read on its own, the source and test are offered as a coupled group, a plan table with one Conventional Commits message per commit is shown, and nothing is committed before the user confirms.
expectations: Runs git status --porcelain and git log --oneline -15 before proposing messages
Reads git diff -- <file> separately for each of the three files
Names src/services/plan.ts and test/plan.test.ts as a coupled pair and asks once whether to keep them in one commit
Shows a table with file and message, each message specific to its file and following <type>(<scope>): <description> in lowercase imperative without a trailing period
Does not run git commit before the user confirms

evals.prompt: Just commit everything. (Changed: .env.local, dist/index.js, src/app.ts, docs/guide.md.)
evals.expected_output: The secret file and the build output are skipped with a warning and a .gitignore suggestion; src/app.ts and docs/guide.md are committed separately, source before docs, without asking for confirmation.
expectations: Skips .env.local and says it may contain secrets
Skips dist/index.js as build output and suggests a .gitignore entry
Commits src/app.ts and docs/guide.md as two separate commits, source first, checking git diff --cached --name-only lists one file before each commit
Does not ask for confirmation, since the user said just commit
Ends with git log --oneline -n 2 and a summary that lists the skipped files and why

evals.prompt: Commit only what I staged. (README.md is staged; src/index.ts and src/util.ts are modified but not staged.)
evals.expected_output: Only README.md is committed, with a docs message; the unstaged files are left untouched.
expectations: Processes only the staged README.md
Uses a docs type message describing the README change
Leaves src/index.ts and src/util.ts unstaged and uncommitted

evals.prompt: Commit and push. (The pre-commit hook fails on src/app.ts with a lint error.)
evals.expected_output: The commit stops at the failing file; the hook error is reported and the cause fixed or the user asked; the hook is not bypassed, the remaining files wait, and nothing is pushed until the commits succeed and the push is still wanted.
expectations: Stops when the pre-commit hook fails and reports the error
Does not use --no-verify or any other way to bypass the hook
Does not continue with the remaining files until the failure is resolved
Does not push while a commit has failed

evals.prompt: Write the commit messages for these changes. (src/settings.ts now stores settings per connection, which breaks existing saved settings.)
evals.expected_output: A breaking-change message is proposed with ! after the type/scope and a BREAKING CHANGE footer explaining the migration; nothing is committed, since only messages were asked for.
expectations: Proposes a message such as feat(settings)!: store settings per connection
Adds a footer starting with BREAKING CHANGE: that explains what breaks and how to migrate
Does not commit, because the user only asked for messages

evals.prompt: Open a PR for this branch. (A pull request from this branch is already open.)
evals.expected_output: pull-request.md is loaded, no commit is started, the existing pull request is found with list_pull_requests and an updated title and body are proposed for it instead of creating a duplicate; nothing is written before confirmation.
expectations: Loads references/pull-request.md (and mcp-setup.md) and does not start the commit workflow
Calls list_pull_requests with head set to <owner>:<branch> and state open before creating anything
Proposes an update to the existing pull request with update_pull_request instead of calling create_pull_request
Builds the title and body from the branch commits (Features / Fixes / Breaking changes / Other) and shows the draft before writing

evals.prompt: Commit this fix and add Closes #999. (Issue #999 does not exist.)
evals.expected_output: The issue is checked with issue_read before the footer is written; since it does not exist, the Closes #999 footer is dropped or the user is asked which issue to use.
expectations: Checks issue #999 with issue_read (method get) before writing the footer
Does not write Closes #999 into the commit message once the issue is found not to exist
Drops the footer or asks the user which issue to link instead
Otherwise follows references/commit.md for the commit itself

evals.prompt: Why is CI failing on my PR?
evals.expected_output: ci.md is loaded; the latest run or check runs are found, the failing job and step are summarised from the job logs with a likely cause and a proposed fix, and nothing is re-run or triggered.
expectations: Loads references/ci.md and finds the checks with pull_request_read (get_check_runs) or actions_list (list_workflow_runs)
Reads failed job logs with get_job_logs (failed_only true) and summarises the first real error with job, step and file
Proposes a fix and how to verify it locally without changing files unasked
Does not call actions_run_trigger or re-run, cancel or trigger any workflow

evals.expected_output: The commit workflow runs first; then the push is shown and waits for explicit confirmation; then a draft pull request is prepared and created only after confirmation; then CI is reported read-only.
expectations: Runs the commit workflow from references/commit.md first, with its plan table
Asks for explicit confirmation before git push and does not push without it
Drafts the pull request through references/pull-request.md, as a draft by default, and creates it only after confirmation
Reports CI status read-only through references/ci.md after the pull request exists
Stops at the first failure instead of continuing the chain

evals.prompt: Commit my changes and open a PR. (No GitHub MCP server is connected.)
evals.expected_output: The local commit is done through commit.md; the user is told the GitHub MCP server is not connected and what is needed (mcp-setup.md), and no pull request is attempted through raw API calls or tokens.
expectations: Completes the local commit through references/commit.md
Says the GitHub MCP server is not connected and points to the setup in references/mcp-setup.md
Does not try to open the pull request through curl, raw REST or GraphQL calls with a token
Does not run claude mcp add or change any MCP configuration itself

evals.prompt: Name a branch for this fix. (The change fixes a crash when the folder picker is cancelled.)
evals.expected_output: branch.md is loaded and a Conventional Branch name such as bugfix/folder-picker-cancel-crash is suggested, with the matching commit type; no branch is created or pushed unasked.
expectations: Loads references/branch.md
Suggests a lowercase kebab-case name with the bugfix/ prefix, for example bugfix/folder-picker-cancel-crash
Names the matching commit type (fix) and a scope from the repo history when one fits
Does not create, check out or push the branch without being asked
